messages:
maria: Hey — product is asking to enable Hotjar on /billing for a 2-week heatmap run to debug dropoffs. Quick privacy question: will heatmaps/session-replay capture any PII from our pages?

ajay: Session replay can. Heatmaps/clickmaps are lower risk but Hotjar can still capture inputs unless we mask them. We need masking on all forms and to disable recordings for auth flows. @ops-bot any org policy we should follow?

ops-bot: Reminder: Any third-party tool that does session replay or captures user interactions requires Security review + vendor DPA verification. Please submit a vendor-request ticket: https://go/review/vendor-request and attach a data flow diagram.

sophie: Also recommend running in prod only with strict sampling (e.g., 5%) or on a feature-flag. Exclude URLs with account/payment info (/account, /checkout/payment). If product only needs clickmaps (no replay), that's easier to approve.

maria: Product says they only want click maps, not full replay. They want to target the /billing page in prod for 2 weeks. Is click-only allowed without full legal/contract work?

ajay: Clickmaps are generally allowed but must ensure: 1) no form/input values are collected, 2) no custom attributes with PII are sent, 3) retention <= 30 days (prefer 14), 4) limited sampling. Also require vendor contract check to ensure Hotjar won't export raw user data.

ben: I can scope the technical config. Proposed settings: heatmaps only (no recordings), sampling: 5%, mask all inputs and textareas, exclude paths: ["/checkout/payment","/account","/billing/payment-method"], retention: 14d, admin access via SAML only. Snippet I plan to add to our loader:```js
window.hjSettings = {
  heatmaps: true,
  recording: false,
  sampleRate: 5,
  maskSelectors: ['input','textarea','[data-mask=pii]']
};
```

ajay: That config looks good. Two admin items: (a) require vendor to sign DPA limiting analytics usage, (b) vendor should confirm they do not provide session export or partner sharing for our account. Security will need the vendor's data flow diagram.

sophie: Also note support team asked for session links for repros in the past — let's be explicit: RECORDINGS = OFF. If they push for replay later, they need a separate approval with stricter controls.

maria: OK I'll open the vendor-request ticket and attach the proposed config + data flow (once Ben drafts it) and tag security for contract review. Want anyone to review the ticket before I submit?

ben: Will draft the data flow + masking proof. I'll ping here when ready.

ajay: I'll review the ticket and will block rollout until Security and Legal sign off. Thanks — prefer we keep this to clickmaps + strict sampling for now. :thumbsup:
